audience: online store owners who run their orders and stock in ShopWired

useCases.title: Find orders waiting to be dispatched
useCases.text: List the orders by status or date. Open one for its line items and tracking link.

useCases.title: Find an order by customer e-mail
useCases.text: Search the orders by keyword, such as a customer e-mail or an order reference.

useCases.title: Check the stock of a SKU
useCases.text: Read the stock quantity of one SKU. Search the products to find the SKU.

useCases.title: Set stock or change an order status
useCases.text: Set the stock of up to 15 SKUs, or change an order's status and tracking URL. The customer gets an e-mail only when you choose so.
